about_the_game:
Swing your paddles and overcome the loooooong parcour. In "Paddle Paddle Paddle" you have to paddle (who would have expected...), avoid obstacles and just don't fall into the lava... At the end of the hard and rocky path an incredible prize awaits you (maybe).

You can play the game alone or with a friend. Here you either control both paddles or share control with your game partner. Frustration and mistakes are inevitable here!


Features:
-> Physics-based paddling like in real life (I think)
-> High frustration factor when falling down (friendships could suffer)
-> Local and Online Coop is possible
-> Speedrun timer in the game
-> One giant level with different biomes
-> Input Rebinding option in the Settings
-> Checkpoints can be activated in the Settings
-> Different Paddle-Type (Realistic or Arcade) in the Settings

Information about the development:
My name is Mateo and I am the 22 year old solo developer of the game. The idea for "Paddle Paddle Paddle" came to me while I was taking a shower and I wanted to mix an only-up like parkour with a physics-based paddle boat mechanic. The whole video game was a little experiment and will be developed and released within a month. I hope you still have fun (and hopefully not too much frustration) with the game.
